mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the cases when FEDFUNDS is low, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the cases when UNRATE exceeds 5%, the hypothesis is rejected.
